name: ABB IO Write
description: Write a digital or analog I/O signal to an ABB controller once per button press. Sets the signal only on the rising edge of the arm button, then reads it back and errors on a mismatch. The analog toggle selects float (analog) versus int (digital); defaults to digital.

inputParameters.name: controller
inputParameters.description: RWS session from the ABB Controller component. Unconnected writes nothing and yields no error.

inputParameters.name: value
inputParameters.description: Value to write. Coerced to int for a digital signal, kept as a float for an analog one.

inputParameters.name: analog
inputParameters.description: Write an analog signal (float) instead of a digital one (int). Auto-creates a boolean toggle; defaults to false (digital).

inputParameters.name: arm
inputParameters.description: Connect a Button; a True fires the write once. A held or recomputed True never re-commands the controller.

outputParameters.name: receipt
outputParameters.description: Short confirmation string of the write that just fired, e.g. 'wrote DO_1=1'. Empty until the next press.

outputParameters.name: readback
outputParameters.description: The signal value read straight back from the controller after the write, confirming the setpoint took.
